reviews.text: Jason came out the same day I called him to remove a large wasp nest from our front bush. He was friendly, super quick, and reasonably priced!
reviews.author: Katie K.

reviews.text: Had a huge wasps’ nest above my deck. Called Jason and he came the following day to remove it.The day after he was done, I noticed we still have a few wasps around, and noticed that a small part of the nest is still there.
reviews.author: Hazem M.

reviews.text: I have had a few quarterly services done and service is top notch. Both Jason and Rafael have been super polite and informatice. I would highly recommend Pure Pest to anyone looking for reliable and very affordable pest control services. 5 Star!
reviews.author: Thomas B.
